[Effects]
The following will activate when the Ability used is Heal, Recover, Cure, Area Heal, Greater Healing, Area Cure, Area Recovery, or Dignity:
Increases Ability effects by XL.
Increases status ailment resistance by 10 activates as a Blessing skill when Amaterasu's Reflector, Amaterasu's Headdress, and Amaterasu's Garb Gear pieces are equipped in the Main Slot.

[Activation]
When any Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
